_notes: Mass Effect Legendary Edition (Steam appid 1328670) - ME3 test copies. Baseline: ME3 is the only
game where a second player has been made to work, so its test environment is the reference the
Copy next to your work as local/mele-me3.json and set instances_root. Keep game_dir pointed at the
real install: instances are built from it with hard links, so the original is only read.
instances_root MUST be on the same volume as game_dir (B:), because hard links cannot cross volumes.
Save isolation is NOT solved by this file alone. LE derives its save directory from the Windows shell
folder, so every copy shares Documents\BioWare\...\Save. Use tools/saverestore around each test,
and see games/mass-effect-legendary-edition/TEST-ENVIRONMENT.md for the stronger options.
ready.type is 'window' because the game exposes no in-game bridge yet. When one exists, switch to it:
a window only proves a process started, not that the game reached gameplay.
name: Mass Effect Legendary Edition - ME3

rows.why: windowed so two or more copies can coexist; the owner's normal session is fullscreen
small window: the test copies are looked at, not played
a vsync-locked copy sits idle and inflates wall-clock test times

pairs._notes: One running ME3 copy measured ~1.6 GB resident. Two copies plus the owner's session needs headroom. Port base is free for private use; the mod reads its role and port from its own settings file once that exists.
